card.name: Linking words before enzyme substrate clauses
card.fires_on: Relative words like "which", "that", "are" or "also" right after "drugs", where the clause goes on to say they are metabolized by or are substrates of CYP enzymes or transporters.

modes.label: Drugs that/which are
modes.description: A linking word after "drugs" that opens a clause about being metabolized by or a substrate of CYP enzymes.
modes.example: co-administration of drugs that<< are>> substrates of CYP3A,

modes.label: Drug is also a substrate
modes.description: "also" after a drug is said to be metabolized, leading into another substrate role.
modes.example: Maraviroc is metabolized by CYP3A and is<< also>> a substrate for P-glycoprotein

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words meaning "is" or "become" (in Chinese), which fits a link to a following description of what something is.
card.plain: It marks the small word after "drugs" that begins a statement about which enzymes handle those drugs.
